vector.description: Host conformance (§7.3 nonce reservation, §3.2 `issuer_key` is 'for host bookkeeping only; the `nonce` is already globally unique (§8)'): two presentations from the same verifier fixture return `allow` with `consume_nonces` carrying the SAME `nonce` under DIFFERENT `issuer_key` strings (`A`, then `B`). The unique-insert key for the nonce store is `nonce` alone, so the second presentation MUST be denied as a replay (draft §Architecture: `if not reserve_nonce_atomically(entry): reject("replay")`). Catches a host that keys its store on the tuple `(issuer_key, nonce)` and therefore reserves the rekeyed replay as novel and allows it — a divergence the same-`issuer_key` replay vector (host-nonce-reserve-replay-deny) cannot observe. Additive; runs beside the existing replay and all-or-nothing vectors.
